name: Should drywall repairs be done before painting walls?

mainEntity.name: Should drywall repairs be done before painting walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall repairs must be completed before interior painting begins to ensure a smooth, durable finish. Applying paint over damaged drywall, nail pops, or uneven settling cracks highlights the imperfections rather than hiding them. Fixing drywall first allows compound patches to be properly taped, skimmed, sanded flush, and sealed with primer. Because HH Remodeling handles both drywall repair and finish carpentry, our crew patches holes, textures the surface, and paints the room in a single coordinated scope without needing outside subcontractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Drywall patching, sanding, and priming must occur before painting so wall repairs blend seamlessly under fresh coats of paint.
